best_match.fbbt_term: immature proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm1
best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm1 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'Pm1' is FBbt:00003833 'proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm1'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052321 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary wide-field amacrine neuron that branches as it enters the proximal side of the medulla and forms broad terminal arbors, with mixed pre- and post-synaptic terminals, mainly in medulla layer M9 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Morante and Desplan, 2008).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052321 'immature proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm1' (exact match).
